_comment: Curation layer for #144. Some demo ASINs are delisted and have no image on Amazon's by-ASIN CDN. Each entry maps such an ASIN to a DIFFERENT live ASIN (or a direct image URL) showing the same or a near-identical product, so the demo still gets a real product photo. Regenerate the miss list with: PYTHONPATH=. python scripts/fetch_product_images.py --report
